rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); SkiaCanvas::draw_sdf_shape_with_shader now grows its draw rect by the declared reach exactly as draw_with_sksl already does, refuses a glow or outer feather whose reach is under 3 sigma, and Canvas::sdf_feather_min_reach() exposes that floor as a pure function. Pixels inside the shape rect are unchanged; only the feather that was previously cut at the rect edge now paints. No design-import, Chromium, packaging or authority boundary moves; the Pulp canvas target has not adopted a Vellum package.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart glow paints past the shape rect out to its reach'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'WidgetBridge knob chart glow paints outside the widget rect'
